node.title: Re^3: How can I test for the representation of an integer? (updated!)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [sm@sh],

I'm not quite sure I understand yet, could you provide some more context? Are you trying to determine whether a regex had capture groups or not? If so, how about this?

"1" =~ /1/; print @->1?"yes\n":"no\n"; "1" =~ /(1)/; print @->1?"yes\n":"no\n"; __END__ no yes

This uses the special variable [doc://@-], aka [doc://@LAST_MATCH_START].

Update 2018-09-01: Actually, [doc://@+] will give you the number of capture groups! See my reply [id://1221528|below] for the difference.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
